result.summary: Fixed the S1 finding: pending_source now gated on consent_pd_at !== null. Consented-user fast path unchanged. Unconsented users get the deep-link payload encoded into the consent:agree callback_data (consent:agree:e_<id>__<channel>, reusing parseStartPayload's existing grammar), byte-budget verified live (measured 62-64 bytes, event id never truncated, only the trailing channel text if needed). Chapter assignment (REQ-014's existing order) still runs first after consent, deep-link resolution runs after regardless of whether a chapter pick is still pending. All 5 verification points PASS with real captured output. lint/build/test unchanged at 82/82, no regression. docs/agents/design/REQ-016.md got an appended correction note, original sections preserved per the REQ-014 precedent.
